First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: party pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @joyfulridersclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Joyful Riders DJ Dance Ride at Perennial Cycle group ride

A DJ on a bike trailer leads a slow ride through Minneapolis with stops for dancing. Part of the Summer DJ Dance Ride Series from Perennial Cycle and the Joyful Riders Club. Party pace, nobody left behind.
